items.claim: In 1955, comet Q was sighted by an unverified observer using an unspecified observational method.
items.quote: In 1955, an unverified observer reported a rival sighting of comet Q using an unspecified method.

items.claim: A 1970 peer review process found no independent confirmation of the 1955 sighting and downgraded its status.
items.quote: A 1970 review found no independent confirmation and downgraded the claim to unconfirmed.
